entities.name: LpxB lipid-A-disaccharide synthase
observations: The 380-residue query is an exact sequence match to reviewed Francisella tularensis LpxB proteins Q14G55, A7NAP6, and Q2A4P3.
The query has a predicted molecular mass of 43.09 kDa and theoretical pI of 9.34.
Pfam identifies an LpxB domain (PF02684.22) spanning residues 3–361.
Curated function: condenses UDP-2,3-diacylglucosamine with lipid X to produce lipid A disaccharide, a lipid A biosynthesis intermediate.
EC 2.4.1.182; GO:0008915 lipid-A-disaccharide synthase activity; GO:0009245 lipid A biosynthetic process; GO:0005543 phospholipid binding.

entities.name: LpxB lipid A disaccharide reaction
observations: Lipid X + UDP-2-N,3-O-bis[(3R)-3-hydroxyacyl]-alpha-D-glucosamine → lipid A disaccharide + UDP + H+.
The reaction is mapped to Rhea RHEA:67828 and catalyzed by EC 2.4.1.182.

entities.name: Lipid A biosynthesis
observations: LpxB functions in bacterial lipid A biosynthesis and outer-membrane lipopolysaccharide biogenesis.
